service.ar: تأشيرة سياحية متعددة الدخول لمدة 5 سنوات
service.ur: 5 سالہ ملٹی پل انٹری سیاحتی ویزا

about: Get a tourist visa valid for five years with repeated entries and exits.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Visitor category with a passport valid for at least 6 months
UAE health insurance valid for 180 days
Stay is limited to 90 days a year; the page also mentions extension up to 180 days, so confirm with ICP
First entry within 60 days of issue
documents: Bank statement of at least USD 4,000 or equivalent covering the last six months
Proof of where you will stay
Copy of ID for applicants from Afghanistan, Iran or Iraq
fees: Financial guarantee 3,000 AED and deposit 20 AED
channels: ICP Smart App or ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
